extra.description: The HSBC Live+ Credit Card earns up to 8% cashback on dining, entertainment, and shopping spend both local and overseas, as well as up to 5% cashback on Caltex and Shell in Singapore. These bonus rates are unlocked with a min. spend of S$600 per calendar month—all other qualifying spend outside of this earns 0.3% cashback.
